drills.hint: 1st-conjugation: stem чита- + -ю. cha-EE-ta-yu
2nd-conjugation: -ишь ending. ga-va-REESH

drills.q: 'She was reading' (past of читать, feminine) in Russian?
drills.hint: Past agrees with GENDER: -ла for feminine. chee-TA-la
Irregular verb; note т→ч. ya kha-CHOO
Stem change г→ж: могу but можем. mih MO-zhem

drills.q: 'I will read' (finished, perfective прочитать) in Russian?
drills.hint: Perfective present-form = future meaning. pra-chee-TA-yu
Feminine noun. va-DA
spa-SEE-ba — from 'спаси Бог', save [you] God
drook — female friend is подруга
see-VOD-nya — the 'г' is pronounced 'v'
vrach — same word for male and female

drills.q: Put книга (book) in the accusative after 'я читаю ___'.
drills.hint: Feminine -а → -у for the direct object. KNEE-gu

drills.q: After 'у меня нет ___', put вода (water) in the correct case.
drills.hint: нет always takes the GENITIVE. va-DY

drills.q: After 'пять' (five), what case does стол (table) take: пять ___?
drills.hint: 5+ takes the genitive PLURAL. sta-LOF

drills.q: Say 'I have a cat' using есть and кошка.
drills.hint: у + genitive (меня) + есть + nominative. oo mee-NYA yest KOSH-ka
syem — the ь (soft sign) is silent but softens м

drills.q: 'What time is it?' — how to ask in Russian?
drills.hint: ka-TO-ryy chas — literally 'which hour'

drills.q: 'Excuse me' (to get attention, formal) in Russian?
drills.hint: eez-vee-NEE-tye — also means 'sorry'

drills.q: 'How much does this cost?' in Russian?
drills.hint: SKOL-ka E-ta STO-eet — the key shopping phrase
не before the verb. ya nye pa-nee-MA-yu
